signals.summary: The autumn decorating changeover — warm woods, cocooning textures, seasonal styling and 'burrowcore' cosiness. Seasonal window opening now, all styled-room imagery.
signals.why_now: A dense cluster of fall-decor features inside the window: Homes & Gardens '7 Biggest Fall Trends for 2026' (28.2h), ELLE Decor '6 Fall 2026 Interior Trends' (62.1h), veranda '6 Fall Decorating Trends' (93.5h), plus 'burrowcore' as autumn's cosiest look (22.6h).

signals.summary: Small-space styling — visual-clutter removal, multifunctional furniture, tiny-apartment layouts — timed to the back-to-school/dorm season. Styled rooms, no people needed.
signals.why_now: Fresh clustered coverage (Architectural Digest visual-clutter guide 105.1h, Yahoo 'make a small living room look larger' 58.5h, New Atlas affordable tiny house 59.1h) alongside r/malelivingspace and r/DesignMyRoom dorm posts.

signals.summary: A move away from beige toward saturated jewel tones and bold '80s-inflected colour in decorating — painted rooms and swatches, cleanly producible.
signals.why_now: Better Homes & Gardens 'Jewel-Toned Color About to Be the Star of Fall Decorating' (110.9h), Design Milk 'Valspar 2027 Color of the Year' (33.4h) and House Beautiful on an '80s bold-decor comeback (107.6h).

signals.summary: A return to inherited, heirloom and American-made furniture — the antique staple 'from grandma's house' reframed as both stylish and durable. Furniture stills, high producibility.
signals.why_now: Repeated across furniture/decor desks within a day: 'Designers Are Bringing Back This Furniture Staple From Grandma's House' (9.5h) and '19 American-Made Furniture Brands Worth Investing In' (10.6h), alongside heritage-millwork slow-living coverage.
